verdict.rationale: Anytype publishes a versioned API reference and an OpenAPI v2 spec. The evidence says outright that no try-it console is published, and nothing shows runnable examples, so a static reference with a downloadable spec does not deliver an interactive, runnable API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The API reference is versioned with dated releases
Anytype publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI document at developers.anytype.io/openapi-v2.yaml
